sections.h2: Why Fort White homes turn green
body: Tree canopy, river humidity, and slow-drying walls make algae and mildew the most common exterior complaint we hear near Ichetucknee and in Three Rivers Estates. Growth shows up first on north walls, under eaves, along the bottom rows of siding, and on roofs under overhanging branches. Pressure washing in Fort White, FL needs to kill that growth, not just rinse it, or it comes back within months. Our mold on siding guide explains what you are looking at.

Soft washing uses low pressure with a cleaning solution that kills algae and mildew at the root. It is the right method for painted siding, stucco, soffits, screens, and roofs, where high pressure can gouge the surface or force water behind it. Higher pressure is saved for concrete driveways, walkways, and pool decks. Wood decks and fences get a gentler wash before staining, so the grain isn't torn up.
bullets: House washing for siding, stucco, and soffits
Deck and fence cleaning before stain

body: Every exterior repaint starts with a wash and mildew treatment, followed by drying time, and on shaded homes that drying time is longer. If peeling paint, soft trim, or failed caulk shows up during the wash, the crew lead photographs it. That gives you an early, documented look at what the next paint job will involve, so the repaint estimate holds no surprises. Cleaned surfaces also show their true color, which makes it easier to decide whether a repaint is needed yet. Concrete washed before a garage floor coating or masonry paint gets the same treatment: clean, dry, and checked before anything is applied. If you are planning a repaint, ask about pairing the wash with exterior painting in Fort White.

Plants are rinsed before and after cleaning, and runoff is managed instead of left to wash across the yard. On riverfront lots, we keep an eye on where water goes. Commercial washing can be scheduled before or after business hours. For more detail, see our main pressure washing and soft washing page, or return to the Fort White overview.

faqs.q: How do you remove algae from a shaded Fort White home?
faqs.a: With a soft wash. A low-pressure cleaning solution kills algae and mildew at the root so it doesn't come right back.

faqs.q: Can you clean my roof without damaging shingles?
faqs.a: Roofs are soft washed with low pressure, never blasted.

faqs.q: Will washing damage my wood deck?
faqs.a: Decks get a gentler wash so the grain isn't torn up, then dry fully before any stain goes on.

faqs.q: Do I need to wash before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Paint over mildew, chalk, or pollen won't bond properly, so washing is standard prep on every exterior project.
